question: The Guru Kelucharan Mohapatra Award has been instituted in the year 1995. Guru Kelucharan Mohapatra was recognized for which dance form?
solution:
The correct answer is __Odissi.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Odissi__ is one of the 8 classical dances of India recognized by the Sangeet Natak Academy.
 
• Odissi is a major ancient classical dance that originated in the Indian state of Orissa.
 
• The famous dancers of Odissi are -
 __
 
• Sujata Mohapatra, Kelucharan Mohapatra, Ratikant Mohapatra, Gangadhar Pradhan, etc.
 
 
 
• Kelucharan Mohapatra is the first person to receive the Padma Vibhusan from Orissa.
